turns.prompt_text: I'm at a John Deere facility here in Johnston Iowa is there anything cool I can do here
turns.response_html:
Since the Johnston facility primarily houses financial and administrative offices, you might enjoy heading about 15 minutes east to the John Deere Des Moines Works in Ankeny for a guided factory tour. They offer a behind-the-scenes look at the assembly of turf equipment and cotton pickers, featuring advanced robotics and manufacturing technology.

If you’d prefer to stay closer to your current location, here are a few other options:

Museums & History

The Iowa Gold Star Military Museum at Camp Dodge is a highly rated, free attraction featuring historical vehicles, aircraft, and exhibits honoring Iowa veterans.

  • Diverse collection of military hardware including tanks and helicopters.
  • Extensive displays covering the Civil War through modern conflicts.
  • Interactive elements and rare artifacts from Iowa's military history.

Recreation & Views

Saylorville Lake Visitor Center and the nearby Terra Park offer scenic trails and outdoor activities just minutes away.

  • A "sunset lookout" at Camp Dodge features decommissioned fighter jets against the skyline.
  • Terra Park includes a fishing lake, large play structures, and miles of paved trails.
  • The lake area is excellent for a quick drive to see the dam or go for a walk.

Social & Games

Backpocket Pin and Pixel is a local hub for entertainment and a bite to eat in the Johnston Town Center.

  • Features a large selection of retro arcade games and duckpin bowling.
  • Offers a variety of local craft beers and a menu of tavern-style comfort food.
  • Located within a walkable plaza that often hosts outdoor events and movies.

Are you looking for a more technical experience, or just somewhere to relax for an hour?

turns.prompt_text: so for the John Deere in Ankeny can I schedule a tour
turns.response_html:
Yes, you can schedule a tour at the John Deere Des Moines Works in Ankeny, but all factory tours require an advance reservation. Tours are free and typically highlight the manufacturing of sprayers, cotton pickers, and tillage tools.

To book your visit, you can contact their visitor services at 515-289-8147 or email desmoinestours@johndeere.com.

Tour Requirements

  • Age: Participants must be at least 13 years old.
  • Attire: Long pants and closed-toed shoes are mandatory; safety gear like hard hats and glasses will be provided.
  • Electronics: Cell phones and cameras are strictly prohibited inside the facility and should be left in your vehicle.
  • Identification: A valid driver's license or passport is required for badge access upon entry.

Would you like me to find some dining options in Ankeny for after your tour?
